The FTSE 100 water company said its long-term incentive plan (LTIP) would increase from 200% of new chief executive James Jesic ’s base salary to 400%, according to changes revealed in the company’s most recent annual report. Jesic could receive as much as £4.8m in a single year after salary, annual bonus, LTIP and benefits are counted. Continue reading...
